queries_run: Vale iron ore China customers diversify supply Simandou CMRG 2026

findings.claim: S&P Global 指出 Simandou 區塊是中國將鐵礦供應從澳洲、巴西分散的核心；首船商業貨 2026-01 運抵中國並交給中國寶武。
findings.source: S&P Global Market Intelligence, Simandou's iron ore shipments signal major industry shift

findings.claim: Vale CFO Bacci 稱與 CMRG 無長約或固定定價，關係正面，並提出方案解決 CMRG 提出的物流問題。
findings.source: mining.com, Vale says China, iron ore suppliers are mutually dependent
findings.excerpt: long-term contracts or fixed pricing arrangements with CMRG, Bacci said. CMRG said earlier this week the way the industry sets prices is “irrational” and vowed to address what it called a value imbalance between miners and steelmakers. The company’s research arm said the current market mechanism is “unfair and unreasonable” and driving prices higher. Vale has a “pretty positive relationship”

note: Vale 為大宗商品礦商，客戶為多家鋼廠，無單一客戶 second-source/in-house 概念；僅查到中國端供應分散（Simandou）與 CMRG 集中議價。搜尋摘要未提供 Vale CFO 談話日期。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
